item.title: ‘Saipan is still beautiful,’ says Japanese tourist
item.description: SAIPAN has changed a lot since Hiroshi last visited 30 years ago, but “it’s still a beautiful island,” he said. He was one of the Japanese tourists who stopped in Saipan aboard the Mitsui Ocean Fuji Cruise, a luxury ship from Tokyo, on Wednesday. item.title: Asuka III brings hundreds of passengers on inaugural Saipan visit
item.description: ASUKA III, Japan’s newest flagship vessel operated by NYK Cruises, made its inaugural arrival in Saipan on Wednesday, Dec. 31, docking at 6:30 a.m. and departing at 5 p.m. The visit followed the arrival of the Mitsui Ocean Fuji on Dec. 30 and a stop in Guam the day before reaching Saipan.
